title: Gravy Sep
text: Gravy Sep. AFTER throwing away the wrapper I see it must be hand washed??? I put in dishwasher anyway and then gave it away. I am wiser each time about ordering online.  Same cheap crap as in all our stores only we are foolish enough to pay to ship back and forth!

product_metadata.title: Farberware Classic 2-Cup Gravy Separator
features: NO MESS: The Farberware 2-Cup Gravy Separator boasts a pour spout and a built-in strainer with lip to prevent messy spills.
MULTIPLE USES: This separator can be used for portioning both liquid and dry ingredients.
COMFORT GRIP: The separator features a soft, non-slip handle for added control; never worry about being comfortable when using.
HEAT-RESISTANT: This gravy separator is constructed from durable, heat resistant plastic.
DISHWASHER SAFE: The Farberware Classic 2-Cup Gravy Separator is dishwasher safe for easy clean up.
description: This Farberware Classic 2-Cup Gravy Separator is an ideal tool for straining fat from beef stock and pan drippings from your roasts. This separator boasts a pour spout and a built-in strainer with lip to prevent messy spills. The separator can be used for portioning liquid and dry ingredients. The separator features a soft, non-slip handle for added control. This tool is constructed from durable, heat-resistant plastic. This product is completely dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.
